svg.title: Transmission through a polarizing filter
svg.desc: Polarized light with its electric field E at angle θ to a filter’s axis approaches the filter. Only the component parallel to the axis, E cos θ, is transmitted. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Malus’s law: project the field, then square it
Linearly polarized input. The transmitted field is its signed projection onto the analyzer axis;
intensity is nonnegative and proportional to cos²θ.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
